proof.text: The only endings with a winner in the spec are `rules.reach` (a king, K, arriving on rank 8) and `rules.win` checkmate. (1) `pieces[K].region` is ranks 2 to 7 for White and, reflected, ranks 7 to 2 for Black: no king may ever stand on rank 8, so `rules.reach` cannot fire. (2) `rules.forbid_check` makes giving check illegal, so no position is check, and checkmate needs check. (3) `rules.stalemate` is a draw. Nothing else in `rules` decides a game (no extinction, check limit, territory or scoring), so every game ends drawn by stalemate or a clock. The kings start on a2 and h2, inside the region.
